title: Active Text Block Island Runtime State Checklist

items.label: Capture the current Project Control, terminology, Editor boundary, and runtime state context before implementation.
items.evidenceTarget: Project Control entrypoint, terminology, Editor AGENTS.md, existing text-block authoring boundary, backend rich-inline request shape, and Editor runtime state modules are reviewed.
items.verificationNote: Reviewed Project Control AGENTS.md, the active 8h Work record, FlowDoc terminology docs, Editor AGENTS.md, docs/TEXT_BLOCK_AUTHORING_BOUNDARY.md, src/editor/draft/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.ts, src/editor/backend/backendMutationRequests.ts, and adjacent Editor runtime state modules before editing.

items.label: Verify the Editor baseline before adding runtime state.
items.evidenceTarget: A clean Editor feature worktree passes npm run check before implementation.
items.verificationNote: The Editor worktree fd-ed-ati-0830 installed dependencies with npm ci and the baseline npm run check passed type-check, 91 test files with 316 tests, and build; npm audit reported 5 existing high severity vulnerabilities and Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning.

items.label: Write a focused failing test for memory-only active text-block island runtime behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused test fails because the runtime state module does not exist yet.
items.verificationNote: npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts failed because ../editor/draft/activeTextBlockIsland could not be found.

items.label: Implement only the tested memory-only active text-block island runtime state and boundary docs.
items.evidenceTarget: The implementation adds runtime state helpers without React component, canvas text input, WYSIWYG behavior, Backend file, or Core file changes.
items.verificationNote: Editor commit 24219dc0d6e5ec79368c82b159b37e3f9a0b9ed5 adds src/editor/draft/activeTextBlockIsland.ts, src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts, and updates docs/TEXT_BLOCK_AUTHORING_BOUNDARY.md. It opens one active text-block draft at a time, clones local rich-inline children, tracks local draft revision and IME state, builds Backend rich-inline replacement requests through the authoring boundary, and records stale rejection without discarding newer local draft state.

items.label: Prove the runtime behavior with focused tests and existing boundary guard tests.
items.evidenceTarget: The focused runtime test, text-block boundary test, and existing source boundary guard all pass.
items.verificationNote: npx vitest run src/tests/activeTextBlockIsland.test.ts src/tests/textBlockAuthoringBoundary.test.ts src/tests/boundary.test.ts passed 3 test files and 11 tests.

items.label: Run full Editor gates in the worktree and after merging to main.
items.evidenceTarget: Both the feature worktree and merged Editor main pass npm run check.
items.verificationNote: Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, 92 test files with 319 tests, and build; Vite retained the existing chunk-size warning.

items.label: Record cleanup risk and verify repository status before Project Control registration.
items.evidenceTarget: Editor and Core status are clean, and the retained Editor worktree cleanup risk is recorded instead of hidden.
items.verificationNote: Editor main and Core status were clean after the Editor main gate. The feature worktree C:/Users/nekot/Documents/GitHub/fd-ed-ati-0830 was intentionally retained because the previous Editor worktree cleanup exposed dependency-link side effects that deleted Core tracked files under packages/text-engine-rust-wasm.
